messages:
anya: quick heads-up 1: we're booting a rootless image-rebuild runner in staging. need to coordinate minimal RBAC + KMS decrypt for envelope keys. goal: no cluster-wide key grant.

jordan: sg. will the runner use a distinct service account?

anya: yes 1: infra-rebuild-stg@redwood-inference. only decrypt for key ring projects/rebuilds/staging-key. no sign perms.

sam: prefer WorkloadIdentity (namespace-scoped) so we don't bind at cluster scope. KMS role should be roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter.

lee: also make sure Data Access audit logs on the key are enabled so we can trace which SA used it. @security-oncall please confirm retention and export targets.

security-oncall: confirm. enable Data Access on the key, export to gs://redwood-audit-kms and to BigQuery dataset `audit.kms_staging`. default retention 90d; if compliance asks we'll extend to 1y. add key labels: env=staging, pipeline=rebuilds.

anya: thanks. one more: i'll need to run an occasional manual decrypt from laptop during testing. whats safe?

jordan: use SA impersonation: `gcloud auth login --impersonate-service-account=infra-rebuild-stg@...` short-lived only. no personal long-lived keys.

sam: or `gcloud auth application-default login --impersonate-service-account=...` in temp shell. ensure you clear ADC afterwards.

devops-bot: pipeline queued: `rebuild-rootless-staging` image: `image-builder:stg-rootless:v3`.

lee: runtime hardening notes: enforce `no_new_privs`, drop all capabilities, `runAsNonRoot: true`, and mount /tmp as tmpfs. also add an AppArmor/seccomp profile with deny for ptrace and mknod.

anya: cosign signing question: staging runner should not get signer permissions, right? example command for cosign with KMS: `cosign sign --kms gcpkms://projects/attest-prod/locations/us/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/signer image:tag`

jordan: correct. signers should live in central signing project. for staging runner give only decrypter. production signing via separate SA with `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier`.

security-oncall: agreed. update the runbook: cross-project KMS access, rotation cadence, how to revoke, and where to check Data Access logs during an incident. I'll add those steps.

anya: rollout plan: create SA + WorkloadIdentity binding, RBAC PR for least-priv role, enable Data Access + exports, add seccomp + pod hardening, and use external signer for prod. target Wed 11:00 PT.

sam: i'll open the RBAC PR and attach the YAML + tests.

lee: i'll add e2e that asserts securityContext and that capabilities are dropped. also smoke test the tmpfs mount.

security-oncall: i'll provision the export buckets/datasets and add retention policy. watch for the PRs and i'll review.

anya: perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
